cases.brief: Create one dense decision page for an operations review. The claim is: P1 incident hours fell 38% while protected workload grew 27%. Show eight half-year observations, distinguish measured bars from the indexed line, call out the endpoint comparison, and end with the next constraint. Use supplied numbers only and label the data as illustrative.
acceptance: no continuous line through an unknown observation

cases.brief: Create one management page explaining a quarter that grew revenue but missed the service-level target. Include the supplied revenue, margin, incident, and target figures, a short cause/effect explanation, and one explicit owner action. Use a restrained editorial system: one ink color, one accent, thin rules, and readable source notes.
acceptance: the action is visually downstream of the evidence

cases.brief: Create one architecture page for a telemetry pipeline: edge collectors send events to a validation layer, then to a stream processor, feature store, and alert service. Show the causal path, a failure boundary, and the one latency number that matters. Prefer native nodes and connectors over decorative shapes.
acceptance: every connector has an unambiguous source and destination
motion is optional and structural only

cases.brief: Create one research-results page for a controlled experiment. Show the hypothesis, baseline and treatment means, a confidence interval, sample sizes, and the decision rule. Use a formula only for the stated effect calculation. Make uncertainty and missing observations explicit.
acceptance: effect and uncertainty are not conflated

cases.brief: Create one teaching page that explains a three-step incident response loop: detect, contain, learn. The audience should be able to repeat the sequence after one minute. Use one sourced contextual image or icon only if it clarifies the loop, and use a short progressive reveal without auto-advance.
acceptance: the three steps read in order
the image has an instructional role
motion does not hide the full static story

cases.brief: Create one product-launch reveal for a quiet home audio device. Establish a memorable visual thesis, show the product promise and three concrete differentiators, and make the hero image carry the atmosphere while editable type carries the claim. Use a deliberate background image, contrast treatment, and display typography without fake product facts.
acceptance: the page has one visual thesis
no stock-photo filler or unsupported claims

cases.brief: Import the assigned source page. Step 1: update the supplied endpoint metric and its label without changing the chart's meaning or any non-target data. Step 2: repair the visual composition so bars, line, labels, and the endpoint callout do not overlap; preserve the source style and all unrelated package parts.

Import the assigned source page. Step 1: change the requested KPI text and one table value using the existing native fields. Step 2: improve the page's hierarchy with a local typography/spacing adjustment and, only if needed, a crop or layer adjustment; preserve the source's communication contract and all non-target content.

Import the assigned engineering page. Step 1: rename one system node and update its measured constraint while keeping the connector topology. Step 2: move or restyle the local node/connector group so the causal path and labels are readable, with no connector or evidence obstruction and no unrelated slide mutation.
editSteps: local geometry and connector readability repair

cases.brief: Import the assigned research page. Step 1: update the supplied sample-size note and one result label, retaining uncertainty and source attribution. Step 2: repair the local table/chart alignment and label spacing so no number, interval, or footnote is hidden; do not change the conclusion or unrelated source parts.

Import the assigned instructional page. Step 1: update one step label and the timing note. Step 2: adjust the image crop/mask or progressive reveal so the teaching sequence remains visible and no overlay covers a connector, label, or evidence object; retain the existing native/editable structure.

Import the assigned launch page. Step 1: replace the supplied product promise text with the approved copy and update one specification label. Step 2: replace or crop the hero image and repair the foreground contrast/type layer so the reveal is premium, legible, editable, and unchanged outside the requested page.
editSteps: hero image/crop and foreground contrast repair
